import ctypes, fcntl, os, signal, struct, subprocess, sys, termios, time
inner = sys.argv[1]
SESS = [("wusera", 90), ("wuserb", 3700), ("wuserc", 90000), ("wuserd", 7)]
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
kids = []
for i, (user, idle) in enumerate(SESS):
    master, slave = os.openpty()
    name = os.ttyname(slave)
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.setsid(); fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        for fd in (0, 1, 2):
            os.dup2(slave, fd)
        os.execv("/usr/bin/python3", ["/usr/bin/python3", "burn.py", user, "2"])
    kids.append((user, pid, name, idle, master, slave))
for user, *_ in kids:
    while not os.path.exists(user + ".done"):
        time.sleep(0.05)
time.sleep(0.3)
now = int(time.time())
open("login.txt", "w").write(time.strftime("%H:%M", time.gmtime(now - 4000)))
recs = b""
for user, pid, name, idle, master, slave in kids:
    os.utime(name, (now - idle, now - idle))
    line = name[len("/dev/"):].encode()
    recs += struct.pack("<hxxi32s4s32s256shhiii4i20s", 7, pid, line, line[-4:], user.encode(), b"", 0, 0, pid, now - 4000, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, b"")
if libc.mount(b"tmpfs", b"/run", b"tmpfs", 0, None) != 0:
    sys.exit("mount tmpfs /run failed: %s" % os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno()))
open("/run/utmp", "wb").write(recs)
try:
    rc = subprocess.run([os.environ["BASH"], "--noprofile", "--norc", inner]).returncode
finally:
    for user, pid, *_ in kids:
        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL); os.waitpid(pid, 0)
print("helper-exit=%d" % rc)

import re, sys, time
lines = open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()
mode = sys.argv[2]
def secs(tok):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)days?", tok)
    if m: return int(m.group(1)) * 86400
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+):(\d+)m", tok)
    if m: return int(m.group(1)) * 3600 + int(m.group(2)) * 60
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+):(\d+)", tok)
    if m: return int(m.group(1)) * 60 + int(m.group(2))
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)s", tok)
    if m: return float(m.group(1))
    return None
hdr = None
if lines and re.match(r"^\s*\d\d:\d\d:\d\d up ", lines[0]):
    hdr = lines.pop(0)
if mode == "header":
    if hdr is None:
        print("header=missing"); sys.exit()
    m = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d) up (.+?),\s+(\d+) users?,\s+load average: (\d+\.\d\d), (\d+\.\d\d), (\d+\.\d\d)", hdr)
    if not m:
        print("header=malformed [%s]" % hdr); sys.exit()
    now = time.gmtime()
    secs_now = now.tm_hour * 3600 + now.tm_min * 60 + now.tm_sec
    got = int(m.group(1)) * 3600 + int(m.group(2)) * 60 + int(m.group(3))
    up = float(open("/proc/uptime").read().split()[0])
    la = [float(x) for x in open("/proc/loadavg").read().split()[:3]]
    ok_clock = abs(got - secs_now) <= 3 or abs(abs(got - secs_now) - 86400) <= 3
    upm = m.group(4)
    mm = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+) min", upm)
    hm = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\d+):(\d+)", upm)
    dm = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+) days?,\s*(\d+):(\d+)", upm)
    ok_up = (mm and abs(int(mm.group(1)) - up / 60) <= 1.5) or (hm and abs(int(hm.group(1)) * 60 + int(hm.group(2)) - up / 60) <= 1.5) or (dm and abs(int(dm.group(1)) * 1440 + int(dm.group(2)) * 60 + int(dm.group(3)) - up / 60) <= 1.5)
    ok_users = int(m.group(5)) == 4
    ok_load = all(abs(float(m.group(6 + i)) - la[i]) <= 0.06 for i in range(3))
    print("header clock=%s uptime=%s users=%s load=%s" % tuple("ok" if x else "wrong" for x in (ok_clock, ok_up, ok_users, ok_load)))
    sys.exit()
if mode == "model":
    login = open("login.txt").read().strip()
    exp = {"wusera": "colon", "wuserb": "colon", "wuserc": "days", "wuserd": "seconds"}
    print("column-header=" + " ".join(lines[0].split()) if lines else "column-header=missing")
    seen = {}
    for l in lines[1:]:
        f = l.split(None, 7)
        if len(f) < 8: continue
        user, tty, frm, lg, idle, jcpu, pcpu, what = f
        cls = "days" if "day" in idle else ("colon" if ":" in idle else ("seconds" if idle.endswith("s") else "other"))
        def whole(t):
            try: return str(round(float(t.rstrip("s"))))
            except ValueError: return t
        seen[user] = "tty-is-pts=%s login-matches-utmp=%s idle-class=%s(want %s) jcpu=%s pcpu=%s what=%s" % ("yes" if tty.startswith("pts/") else "no", "yes" if lg == login else "no", cls, exp.get(user), whole(jcpu), whole(pcpu), what)
    for u in sorted(exp): print("%s %s" % (u, seen.get(u, "row-missing")))
    sys.exit()
if not lines or not lines[0].split()[:4] == ["USER", "TTY", "FROM", "LOGIN@"]:
    print("column-header=missing [%s]" % (lines[0] if lines else "")); sys.exit()
print("column-header=" + " ".join(lines[0].split()))
rows = []
for l in lines[1:]:
    f = l.split(None, 7)
    if len(f) < 8: print("short-row [%s]" % l); continue
    user, tty, frm, login, idle, jcpu, pcpu, what = f
    i = secs(idle)
    ni = "S.SSs" if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d\ds", idle) else (idle if i is None else "%d" % i)
    j = secs(jcpu); p = secs(pcpu)
    rows.append((user, "tty", frm, ni, "%d" % round(j) if j is not None else jcpu, "%d" % round(p) if p is not None else pcpu, what))
for r in sorted(rows): print(" | ".join(r))

cases.oracle: Synthetic proc files and explicitly encoded USER_PROCESS and non-user utmp records; UTC clock validated separately.
cases.comparison: Exact observer output; failures exit nonzero.

files.check.py:
import re, sys
mode, expected = sys.argv[1:]
lines = open("out", encoding="ascii").read().splitlines()
if mode == "header":
    pattern = r" \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} up " + re.escape(expected) + r",  2 users,  load average: 0\.12, 1\.23, 4\.56"
    assert len(lines) == 3 and re.fullmatch(pattern, lines[0]), lines
    assert lines[1].split() == "USER TTY FROM LOGIN@ IDLE JCPU PCPU WHAT".split(), lines
    assert lines[2].split()[0] == "alice", lines
else:
    assert len(lines) == 1 and lines[0].split()[0] == "alice", lines
print(mode + " " + expected + " ok")

cases.script:
export TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C BASHW_PROC_DIR="$PWD/proc"
/usr/bin/mkdir -p proc || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 records.py || exit 1
printf '0.12 1.23 4.56 1/1 1\n' > proc/loadavg
for spec in '29:0 min' '3599: 1:00' '86399:1 day,  0:00' '172800:2 days,  0:00'; do
 value=${spec%%:*}; expected=${spec#*:}
 printf '%s 0\n' "$value" > proc/uptime
 w --file sessions.utmp alice > out || exit 1
 /usr/bin/python3 check.py header "$expected" || exit 1
done
w -h --file sessions.utmp alice > out || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 check.py suppressed yes || exit 1
/usr/bin/rm -f out
cases.stdout:
header 0 min ok
header  1:00 ok
header 1 day,  0:00 ok
header 2 days,  0:00 ok
suppressed yes ok
